name: Shammah
bio: Shammah was Jesse's third son, David's older brother. When Samuel was anointing a new king among Jesse's sons, Shammah passed before him, but the LORD said he had not been chosen (1 Samuel 16:9). He later joined his two older brothers, Eliab and Abinadab, in Saul's army, facing the Philistines at the Valley of Elah (1 Samuel 17:13).
